AUTHOR: Wu
TITLE: Dynamic identification and automatic counting of the number of passing fish species based on the improved DeepSORT algorithm
REGION: Vertical-slot fishway, middle reaches of the Y River, China
SPECIES: Schizothorax o'connori, Schizothorax waltoni, Schizopygopsis younghusbandi, Oxygymnocypris stewartii
DATA: Own fishway camera footage, March 18-24 and April 4-10 2022 (807 videos exported, 322 valid); 13,216 labelled detection images; ReID dataset of 83 fish / 6,274 images
V_EV: Section 4.2: 'The water body and suspended particles in the water make the light suffer from scattering and absorption effects in the water, leading to defects such as low contrast'
D2: 80/20 train/test (random, images extracted every 10 or 5 frames from videos)
D_EV: Section 3.2: '13,216 labeled images are made into target detection data sets, which are randomly divided into training sets and test sets according to the proportion of 8:2.'
R_EV: Section 3.3.1: 'The five models in the trained YOLOv5 were tested under the same test set.'
C_EV: Section 4.1: 'at frame 169, the algorithm matches the original ID1 target and recovers its tracking'; ReID 'can effectively recover targets lost due to occlusion or missed detection'
E_EV: Section 3.4: 'compare the output results of the algorithm with the results of manual counting to evaluate the accuracy of the algorithm.' (Table 5: average counting accuracy 75.5%)
ARCH: YOLOv5 (n/s/m/l/x; YOLOv5x selected) + improved DeepSORT (deeper ReID network, 128x64 input) + virtual baseline up/down counting
METR: Precision, recall, AP, mAP@0.5/0.8/0.5:0.95, FPS; ReID top-1 error; counting accuracy ACP/mACP vs manual counts
NOTE: Detection set is a random 8:2 frame split from fishway videos (frames sampled every 10/5 frames), no leakage discussion. Counting evaluated against two researchers' manual counts of the same videos; whether counting videos were excluded from detector training is not stated. C5 coded for explicit ID-recovery via improved ReID and discussion of re-appearing fish counted as new targets (30-frame retrieval limit); no detection confidence threshold reported (Mahalanobis/cosine gating thresholds only), so C_ALL=P. Illumination: LED light wall and light compensation, footage spanning morning/noon/evening (V3=Y); turbidity only qualitative. Data availability: 'will be made available by the authors'.
